# QuadTree Visualizer

> A high-performance interactive simulation visualizing the efficiency of
> the QuadTree data structure in spatial partitioning and collision
> detection, built with Next.js and HTML5 Canvas.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
Co-author: Hasan Rizvi
Co-author: Mega Satish, ORCID 0000-0002-1844-9557
Institution: Terna Engineering College, University of Mumbai
Programme: B.E. Computer Engineering, Fourth Year, Semester VIII
